name: Sort-last Parallel Rendering
aliases: Distributed Volume Rendering with Post-rendering Compositing
definition: Divides the dataset into portions, renders each portion separately on different processors, and composites all sub-images at the end.
summary: Sort-last parallel rendering partitions volume data across processors for independent rendering, then composites full-resolution partial images in depth order, distinguishing itself from sort-first methods by keeping data distribution fixed regardless of view angle.
